layer1.name: Everpix
layer1.one_liner: Cloud photo storage that organised your entire library automatically.
layer1.description: Uploaded every photo you had across devices and services, de-duplicated them, and surfaced the good ones. Freemium: unlimited access at $5/month or $49/year. Widely praised product quality at t0, with conversion unproven.
layer1.outcome_note: Shut down with roughly 55,000 users, too few of them paying to cover storage costs. A willingness-to-pay failure with a product nobody disputed was good.

sources.note: VentureBeat report, covers the cost structure
